text: dsh-tuanjie-plugin（DSH 网页客户端插件）：把团结引擎编辑器接入 DSH，通过本机 Codely 桥连接已打开的工程，并注册状态查询、命令枚举、命令执行、编辑器内 C# 执行和桥 CLI 五个工具。可查看在线编辑器与可用命令，创建或修改场景物体、组件和资源，调用编辑器操作并读取执行结果。适合用 AI 辅助团结引擎游戏开发、检查场景或自动执行编辑器任务；编辑器和目标工程须已运行且提供 Codely 桥，不需要额外安装桥适配器。

dsh-tuanjie-plugin connects DSH to an open Tuanjie editor via its local Codely bridge. Five tools inspect status, list and run commands, execute C# in the editor, and call the CLI. Use it for AI-assisted game development and scene editing; the project and editor must already be running.
想让 DSH 帮我直接操作团结引擎里的场景和游戏物体。
怎么让 AI 查询当前打开的团结编辑器并列出它支持的命令？
我想通过对话创建或修改团结引擎项目中的 GameObject 和组件。
有没有办法让 DSH 在团结编辑器进程里运行一小段 C# 并返回结果？
I want my assistant to inspect and control an already open Tuanjie editor project.
Can DSH run editor commands and C# code inside the Tuanjie editor?
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 的功能「团结编辑器连接状态」：通过 tuanjie_status 查询当前可连接的编辑器实例及状态；目标编辑器需已运行并加载带 Codely 桥的工程。
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 的功能「命令发现与执行」：先用 tuanjie_list_commands 获取编辑器命令和 action，再用 tuanjie_command 传入命令名及参数，执行场景、物体、组件等操作。
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 的功能「编辑器内运行 C#」：调用 tuanjie_eval 提交 C# 语句，在编辑器进程中执行并取得 JSON 信封结果。
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 的功能「桥接 CLI 调用」：调用 tuanjie_cli 传入底层适配器参数，可查询状态、编辑器列表、执行命令或使用 shell 会话。
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 的功能「本地桥协议适配」：内置 Node 桥客户端读取项目心跳文件中的端口并连接本机 TCP Codely 桥，插件默认无需外部适配器程序。
dsh-tuanjie-plugin 使用前须知：它只能连接已运行并加载目标工程的团结编辑器，不能替用户启动编辑器；桥接客户端从工程心跳配置发现本机 TCP 端口。
团结项目里怎么让 DSH 帮忙查询场景层级或检查编辑器状态？
I need an assistant to list editor actions and apply them to my open Tuanjie project.

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · dsh-tuanjie-plugin：[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that drives the **Tuanjie (团结引擎)** editor — connect to a running editor's Codely bridge, build and modify scenes and GameObjects, edit component properties, run editor commands, and execute C# inside the editor process.

**Docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)** (中文文档)

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add github:ThePuristImpurity/dsh-tuanjie-plugin
```

Or search for `tuanjie` in the DeepSeek Harness plugin marketplace.

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Requirements：The Tuanjie editor must already be running with the target project loaded, and that project must ship the Codely bridge (`cn.tuanjie.codely.bridge`, bundled with Tuanjie by default). This plugin cannot launch the editor for you.

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `tuanjie_status` | List connectable editor instances (port, project root, state) |
| `tuanjie_list_commands` | List every command the editor exposes, with supported actions |
| `tuanjie_command` | Run a named command, e.g. `manage_gameobject` + `["create", "--name", "Player"]` |
| `tuanjie_eval` | Execute C# inside the editor process with full `UnityEngine` / `UnityEditor` access |
| `tuanjie_cli` | Run the underlying bridge subcommands (`status` / `editors` / `command` / `shell`) |

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Reliability (0.1.1)：The 0.1.0 line had one nasty failure mode: **a wrong argument type was silently dropped by the bridge while it still answered `success: true`**. 0.1.1 normalizes and validates arguments in the CLI adapter, so these either work or fail loudly:

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Reliability (0.1.1)：| Invocation | 0.1.0 | 0.1.1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--position "1,2,3"` | silently dropped, nothing moves | coerced to an array, actually applies |
| `--componentsToAdd BoxCollider` | silently dropped, Transform only | wrapped into an array |
| `--propertyValue "1,2,3"` | **zeroes out the vector** | coerced to an array, no longer zeroed |
| `--types warning` | ignored, returns every type | returns warnings only |
| `--name=X` (equals form) | stored as a key literally named `name=X` | equivalent to the space form |
| `delete --name X` | `Target GameObject ('') not found` | rejected, tells you to use `--target` |
| `--output out.png` | silently ignored | rejected, points at `--path` / `--filename` |
| misspelled flag (e.g. `--filterTypo`) | silently ignored | rejected with a spelling suggestion |
| `apply_text_edits` without line/column | inserts at the top of the file, still reports success | rejected before sending |
| `--imports System.Text` | overrides the default namespaces, `CS0103` | merged into the defaults |
| `modify --componentName X --propertyName Y --propertyValue Z` | reports success, **field keeps its old value** | reje

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Reliability (0.1.1)：An unknown argument is now caught **before the request is sent**, and the error lists every parameter that tool accepts. If the bridge answers with `No modifications applied`, `0 targets found`, or `not found using method`, the envelope is downgraded to a failure.

Even so, **verify writes with `tuanjie_eval`** — the plugin cannot change the bridge's own behaviour.

`tuanjie_eval` accepts quotes and backslashes as written (no escaping needed), and `Debug.Log` output comes back in `data.logs`.

dsh-tuanjie-plugin README · Known limitations：- The bridge **cannot launch the editor**; it only attaches to a running instance.
- `capture_game_view` is disabled by the bridge. Use `manage_gameview`, or `record_game_view` on `exec_runtime_script` (requires `ffmpeg`).
- Screenshots land where `--path` + `--filename` say (relative paths resolve against the project root); read the real path from `data.path`. `--path` may name the file directly when it ends in `.png` (`--path screenshots/Foo.png`): the value is split into directory + file name, while an extension-less `--path` still means a directory that the bridge names itself. Captures always write PNG — the bridge appends `.png` to `--filename` whatever it is given — so other image extensions (`.jpg`, `.gif`, …) are rejected with an error instead of silently turning into a directory.
- Keyboard and mouse-move input via `manage_input` needs the Input System package (`com.unity.inputsystem`). Clicking uGUI elements does not — it goes through the EventSystem.
- `tuanjie_cli` is not the Unity Hub CLI: `projects create`, `templates list`, `open`, `pipeline install`, `test`, `build`, `logs` are all unsupported.
